Name: Maaseiah
Summary: Priest who stood beside Ezra at the reading of the law, taught the people, and sang and played at the dedication of the wall (Nehemiah 8:4, 8:7, 12:41, 12:42).
LifeLesson: From hearing the law to teaching it to celebrating it.
RelatedEvents: Ezra Reads the Law; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
